note: Rewritten from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989 (Fauna of India: Isoptera); the original is in English; the original records the alate as Imago Unknown, so no Alate section is given. OCR problem: in 'Head-capsule bicwn at frons', bicwn is probably a corruption of bicoloured, and it has been rendered as 'frons bicoloured', the original sentence being kept in the evidence; the printed book should be checked.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule bicoloured at the frons, paler posteriorly; postclypeus brown, anteclypeus yellowish brown; labrum pale brown; mandibles pale reddish brown, nearly black anteriorly; antennae brownish yellow; pronotum brownish yellow; legs and abdomen pale. Head sparsely pilose; anterior margin and disc of the labrum with a few setae. Head longer than wide, head length (to mandible base) 1.13—1.23, width 0.80—0.88 mm; sides parallel, posterior margin rounded; frons slightly inclined, weakly bilobed; Y suture absent; anterior lateral angles of the head acute. Eyes indistinct. Antennae 9—10-segmented; in the 10-segmented condition segment 2 is 1.5 times segment 3 and segment 3 shortest, in the 9-segmented condition segments 2 and 3 are about equal in length. Labrum slightly wider than long, sides weakly convex, anterior margin broadly rounded. Mandibles long (0.61—0.63 mm) and slender, head-mandible index 0.51—0.54; basal swelling weak; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, right mandible with 2 marginal teeth. Postmentum long, club-shaped, widest in the anterior half; length 0.65—0.67, maximum width 0.32—0.35, waist width 0.17—0.20 mm. Pronotum semicircular; length 0.30—0.32, width 0.73—0.83 mm; anterior margin moderately concave, lateral margins weakly convex, posterior margin convex. Apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3.
